1.name: The Day I Caught a Star
1.overview: Feeling distant from her older sister, a lonely girl chases a strange spaceship and discovers a visitor from a magical land that changes her life.

1.name: Nice to Meet You, I'm Lilly!
1.overview: Dreaming of adulthood, a girl secretly uses magic to transform and explore the city, but a sudden encounter threatens to reveal her hidden power.

1.name: Gazing Up at the Moon
1.overview: A mysterious rookie idol captivates audiences and draws a rival’s attention, then visits a talent agency where new encounters shape her rising career.

1.name: Lulu Pays a Visit
1.overview: Lulu, an idol that suddenly debuted on a music show, becomes hot news, and Fuu hears her singing voice and becomes a fan!. One day, Toko calls Lilly and says "There is someone I want you to meet!" and learns that it's Lulu, whom she admires. However, Lulu is actually also a fan of Lilly...

1.name: Welcome to Hell's Quiz
1.overview: Unaware of each other's secret identities, Fuu and Rui act as idols Lilly and Lulu. This time, four members from the agency, including Toko and Sena, appear on a quiz show! Lilly, who wants to make the show more exciting, secretly uses magic.

1.name: Summer Means a Training Camp!
1.overview: To prepare for their future activities as idols, Lilly, Lulu, Toko, and Sena decide to have a training camp at a seaside cottage! After taking a dip on the private beach, the four of them practice their singing and dancing! But the next day, unexpected trouble....!

1.name: Summer Daydream
1.overview: Lilly suddenly disappears while Lulu and other others are trapped at the training camp because they can't contact the outside world! The three start panicking and search for Lilly, but strange things keep occurring such as things gradually starting to move on their own!

1.name: Autumn Winds and Straw Hats
1.overview: Fuu didn't like the tests in the new school semester, so she used her magic to "become a world without tests!" With the power of her magic, tests and classes disappear. Rui, who senses something is wrong, secretly casts a spell to return the world back to normal! Fuu, not wanting to be defeated, fights back again with magic!

1.name: A Gloomy Saturday
1.overview: Fuu and Rui find out that Rui is actually a fan of Lilly and have fun talking about her! But Fuu's comments cause an awkward atmosphere. After that, they meet Lilly and Lulu by chance, and they begin to confide in each other about their concerns and honest feelings.

1.name: Invited to Felix Star
1.overview: On a moonlit night, Fuu meets the mysterious gentleman and finally decides to visit the magical land of Felix Star to receive a magical lesson. At the same time, Rui was also approached by a suspicious creature in the city.

1.name: Cinderella With a Curfew
1.overview: Finally, Lilly and Lulu's first concert will be held! Alongside their school life, they prepared for their first concert and attending lessons, usually returning home just before curfew! Because of the busy schedule, Lulu... falls ill.

1.name: Let's Sing, LuluttoLilly
1.overview: Fans have gathered and LullutoLilly's first concert has finally begun! With all the unexpected troubles they experienced, the two secretly wished for their first concert, which they created together, to be a success…

1.name: Secret Message
1.overview: Fuu and Lilly's appearance had overlapped which led Rui to believe Fuu is also using magic and begins to secretly follow her. At the same time, a newcomer has arrived to Production Once More…!

1.name: Magical Songstress
1.overview: On the basement floor of a café, Oleans, a magical cat, consults with the residents of the magical land about festivals. On the other hand, Rui, who had been searching for Fuu without hesitation, was worried about Lilly even during the live stream where Asahi was introduced as a new member.

1.name: The Many Faces of Rui
1.overview: Umezo, a resident of Felix Star, the magical land, transformed into a human-like form with a transformation device. However, he forgot to turn off the switch, and Rui, who was nearby, was also transformed into a different person due to the influence of magic. She was supposed to be filming a drama that day, but it was difficult to transform back to...!?

1.name: Surprise Gourmet Battle
1.overview: "LuluttoLilly" decided to try cooking on a streaming program in preparation for appearing at a large-scale festival. Toko prepares a little surprise, but Lilly secretly wishes for the success of her cooking with magic, so she's now in an unexpected situation...!?

1.name: Stars Are Born! More: Once More!
